ai_view.directive: Follow as written. Learn provider behavior at the smallest operational scope where a failure can occur, while using larger scopes to improve statistical estimates — never to override local evidence. A legitimate change in one provider, endpoint, region, concurrency regime, or workload class must never automatically redefine healthy behavior in another. Shared learning may improve predictions, but qualification and fault containment remain scope-specific.

the Simpson's-paradox demonstration as the permanent warning (his two-regime table: low-concurrency 1%→2%, high-concurrency 5%→8%, aggregate 4.6%→2.6% — both regimes worsen while the aggregate improves; each cell keeps its own observations, uncertainty, qualification, incidents; his logit formulation with interaction terms, model selected by held-out validation — statistical pooling is not unbounded evidence pooling: a healthy low-concurrency region may help estimate an uncertain high-concurrency cell but cannot establish its idempotency; inadequate evidence ⇒ UNPROVEN_IN_SCOPE even when the parent predicts excellence); the three operational views (individual scope, standardized provider-wide rate under fixed reference composition, observed provider-wide rate — his standardization math: 0.1(2%)+0.9(8%)=7.4% vs observed 2.6%; concurrency measured at admission before outcomes are known — retry storms must not reclassify themselves; recovery retries never relabeled as ordinary operations; taxonomy changes require migration assessment); cross-scope learning contamination prevention (his scope/evidence/decision table; quarantined scopes' unresolved observations never silently update shared priors; discovered contamination ⇒ identify and reassess every dependent model — the same evidence-dependency principle as Smart Notes and claim qualification); intelligence.essence: Scope-Isolated Baseline Integrity Law: NayaNET shall bind provider-monitoring observations, adaptive baselines and qualification receipts to explicit operational scopes. Hierarchical statistical information sharing may improve estimation but shall not transfer certification beyond demonstrated evidence. Aggregate improvement shall not conceal independently supported local regression, and scope-specific promotion shall preserve unaffected qualifications while rechecking shared dependencies and cross-scope interactions. The desired behavior: 'Provider A has improved overall because more requests now use its faster region. But Region West's high-concurrency recovery operations have independently deteriorated. I will learn the legitimate traffic shift, preserve healthy scopes, and investigate or contain only the affected guarantee.' That is how NayaNET learns collectively without letting the collective average erase local truth. The five-dimension scope key, the Simpson's-paradox warning, the pooling-without-evidence-transfer restriction, the three operational views, the versioned taxonomies, the contamination quarantine, the interaction scopes, the promotion invariant, and the P1–P10 suite are the permanent machinery.
intelligence.falsifier: A healthy aggregate certifying a regressing scope; a parent prediction presented as scope qualification; sparse cells inheriting global PASS verdicts; retry storms reclassifying themselves into easier regimes; recovery retries relabeled as ordinary operations; quarantined observations silently updating shared priors; cross-boundary operations assessed by single-cell health alone; a shared-model promotion skipping neighbor rechecks; a new endpoint inheriting an unearned PASS; an aggregate anomaly generating duplicated operational pages per cell.

human_view.meaning: Learn together, but never let the average lie about the parts. Every measurement gets a five-part address: which provider, which operation, which region, how busy, what kind of work. Because here's the trap, with real numbers: low-traffic mode goes from 1% failures to 2%, high-traffic mode goes from 5% to 8% — both worse — yet the combined number drops from 4.6% to 2.6% because traffic shifted toward the easier mode. A naive system celebrates. Ours must hold both truths: the mix improved, and both modes deteriorated. The architecture shares statistical strength downward — a well-observed easy region helps estimate a sparse hard region — but it never shares *certification*: thin evidence means 'unproven here,' no matter how pretty the parent prediction looks. Promoting one scope's baseline re-checks the neighbors, because shared math means shared side effects. Operations crossing boundaries — a retry that hops regions, a request that becomes a background job — get their own interaction scope, because every cell can look healthy while the handoff breaks the promise. And ten adversarial tests prove it, crowned by ripping out the isolation guard and watching the verifier catch the aggregate hiding the regression. Collective learning, local truth.

intelligence.learning_lesson: This is the scope-integrity layer the learning stack needed: AER-CAL-3 governs promotion; AER-CAL-4 ensures promotion in one scope can't launder a regression in another. The permanent contributions: the five-dimension scope key, the Simpson's-paradox warning as a standing test, the pooling-without-evidence-transfer restriction (UNPROVEN_IN_SCOPE), the three operational views with standardization math, the versioned taxonomies with admission-point measurement, the contamination quarantine with dependent-model reassessment, the InteractionScope construct, the promotion invariant with shared-dependency rechecks, and the P1–P10 suite with the guard-removal mutation. Every future learning system inherits this: share statistics, never share certification.
